versions.content: In the context of EthIf_CtrlModeIndication the function EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode shall be called for all EthSwtPorts of a EthIfSwitchPortGroup if the EthIfController has a reference to a EthIfSwitchPortGroup and the reference is of type "control". If ETH_MODE_DOWN is reque sted, the EthIf has to ensure that only those EthSwtPorts are set to ETH_MODE_DOWN which are not requested ETH_MODE_ACTIVE by another EthIfSwitchPortGroup.

If ET H_MODE_DOWN is requested, the EthIf has to ensure that only those EthSwtPorts are set to ETH_MODE_DOWN which are not requested ETH_MODE_ACTIVE by another EthIfSwitchPortGroup.
